reasons.plausibility: Graphite and MoS2 oxidize or degrade well below 800 °C in air, so they cannot provide lubrication across the full temperature range as proposed.
reasons.testability: The proposed pin-on-disk test with friction and wear measurements is clear and would decisively falsify the hypothesis if no significant reduction is observed.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is not useful because it ignores the well-known high-temperature instability of the suggested solid lubricants, making it a non-viable solution for the stated problem.
